title: Systematic Evaluation of Abrasive Wear Resistance in Smart Cermet Marine Coatings for High-Speed Pump Impellers
authors: Rohit P. Jadhav, Amol D. Wable, Ramachandran Thulasiram, Ripendeep Singh, Nishant Kulkarni
abstract: High-speed marine pump impellers experience severe wear under abrasive seawater conditions, while conventionalcoatings offer limited durability. This research investigates smart and sustainable cermet marine coatings, developed using a single ceramic phase combined with three metallic binders, to identify an optimum composition with enhanced abrasive wear resistance, corrosion resistance, and durability. The coatings were placed on marine-grade stainless steel (AISI 316L) using a high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) thermal spray process and characterized using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray diffraction (XRD). Abrasive wear performance was evaluated through slurry erosion, microhardness, surface roughness, adhesion strength, and electrochemical corrosion testing. Among the three compositions, coating c2 achieved optimum performance, with the highest microhardness (1210 HV), lowest wear rate (10.1 mg/h), and superior adhesion and corrosion resistance. SEM and XRD confirmed a denser, well-bonded microstructure with minimal porosity. The findings demonstrate significantly enhanced wear resistance, corrosion protection, and durability for marine applications.
venue: The International Journal of Maritime Engineering

infographic.engineering_relevance: HVOF-sprayed cermet coatings could improve the wear resistance and corrosion protection of AISI 316L marine pump impellers.

zh-Hans.title: 用于高速泵叶轮的智能金属陶瓷海洋涂层耐磨粒磨损性能的系统评估
zh-Hans.abstract: 高速船用泵叶轮在含磨粒的海水环境中会遭受严重磨损，而传统涂层的耐久性有限。本研究考察了采用单一陶瓷相与三种金属黏结剂结合制备的智能、可持续金属陶瓷海洋涂层，旨在确定具有更高耐磨粒磨损性能、耐腐蚀性能和耐久性的最佳组分配比。采用高速氧燃料（HVOF）热喷涂工艺将涂层沉积在船用级不锈钢（AISI 316L）上，并利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和X射线衍射（XRD）进行表征。通过浆料冲蚀、显微硬度、表面粗糙度、结合强度和电化学腐蚀测试评估耐磨粒磨损性能。在三种组分配比中，涂层c2表现最佳，具有最高的显微硬度（1210 HV）、最低的磨损速率（10.1 mg/h）以及优异的结合性能和耐腐蚀性能。SEM和XRD证实其微观结构更致密、结合良好且孔隙率极低。研究结果表明，这些涂层在海洋应用中的耐磨性能、腐蚀防护性能和耐久性均显著提高。

title: Thermo-Mechanical Modeling and Microstructural Evolution in Rotary Friction Welding of AA6061 Aluminum Alloy
authors: Pham Quang Trung, Dinh Duy Khoa, Nguyen Gia Lam, Ngo Thanh Binh
abstract: Abstract The current study is concerned with the development and experimental validation of the numerical model for RFW of AA6061 Aluminum alloy using the finite element method (FEM) in ABAQUS/Standard. The main objective is to present an efficient and predictive tool for the optimization of the RFW process to reduce the dependency on costly and time-consuming physical experimentation. The numerical model was developed based on the axisymmetric characteristic of the component, using the coupled thermal-mechanical element CGAX4HT in ABAQUS/Standard. The model incorporates temperature-dependent material properties and high-temperature true stress-strain data. The model validation was performed thoroughly by comparing the simulated results of weld morphology, temperature evolution and axial shortening with experimental data, which showed a good agreement between the numerical predictions and the actual experimental observations. After validation, we used the model to perform a detailed analysis of the distribution of temperature, residual stress, equivalent plastic strain, and strain rate in the weld zone, further establishing, for the first time, a direct quantitative spatial correlation between these simulated thermo-mechanical fields and the experimentally measured boundaries of the dynamically recrystallized zone (DRZ), thermo-mechanically affected zone (TMAZ), and heat-affected zone (HAZ). The experimental assessment of the welded joints was carried out by means of microscopy, Vickers hardness test, tensile test, X-ray diffraction (XRD), and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The results reveal a high degree of consistency between the simulation and experimental results and the successful validation, showing that the developed numerical model has a high ability to precisely predict the RFW process for the AA6061, extending beyond the thermal-only validation reported in prior RFW studies.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The model supports welding-process optimization with less reliance on costly physical trials.

zh-Hans.title: AA6061铝合金旋转摩擦焊的热力耦合建模与微观组织演变
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究利用ABAQUS/Standard中的有限元法（FEM），开发并通过实验验证了AA6061铝合金旋转摩擦焊（RFW）数值模型。主要目标是提供一种高效且具有预测能力的工具，用于优化RFW工艺，减少对成本高、耗时长的实物试验的依赖。该数值模型基于构件的轴对称特征，采用ABAQUS/Standard中的热力耦合单元CGAX4HT建立。模型纳入了随温度变化的材料性能和高温真应力–真应变数据。通过将焊缝形貌、温度演变及轴向缩短量的模拟结果与实验数据进行比较，对模型进行了全面验证，结果表明数值预测与实际实验观测吻合良好。验证后，我们利用该模型详细分析了焊接区域内的温度、残余应力、等效塑性应变及应变率分布，并进一步首次建立了这些模拟热力场与实验测得的动态再结晶区（DRZ）、热机械影响区（TMAZ）和热影响区（HAZ）边界之间的直接定量空间关联。采用显微观察、维氏硬度试验、拉伸试验、X射线衍射（XRD）和扫描电子显微镜（SEM）对焊接接头进行了实验评估。结果表明，模拟与实验结果具有高度一致性，模型得到了成功验证，说明所开发的数值模型能够高精度地预测AA6061的RFW过程，超越了以往RFW研究中仅针对热学行为的验证。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework supports process-window selection for reducing weld defects, thermal gradients and axial-force fluctuations in HDPE joints.

infographic.watch_item: Predictive reliability beyond the tested welding parameters and experimental setup remains unestablished.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被公认为连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究结合计算与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动及缺陷形成等特征进行了全面的预测研究，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟不同转速、焊接速度及底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。通过实验数据验证了CEL数值模型，结果表明，该模型在预测孔洞形成以及热响应和力学响应方面与实验结果高度吻合。结果表明，底面预热可有效减小温度梯度并稳定竖直力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热将峰值压入力从1600 N降低至接近1100 N，并将峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C提高至约100 °C，从而减小厚度方向的温度梯度并稳定轴向力分布。同时，使用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），以预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，其R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明其在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的准确性和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域的形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN组合框架能够快速生成工艺图，标示存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在所测试条件下，最优工艺条件为1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C预热；在1000 rpm且不预热时，由于形成隧道型缺陷，观察到较差的可焊性。这些发现为制备可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指导，并展示了将计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持该工艺在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合基于物理的模拟与神经网络，确定了所测试条件下HDPE搅拌摩擦焊的最优工艺条件：1500 rpm、30 mm/min和60 °C底部预热。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架可支持焊接工艺窗口的选择，以减少HDPE接头中的焊接缺陷、温度梯度及轴向力波动。
method: 建立温度、力、材料流动及缺陷形成的三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模型。
使用实验温度和轴向力数据训练两个多层感知机神经网络。
利用模拟和ANN预测结果，绘制存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工况分布图。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验验证表明，ANN的R²值为0.91–0.99；60 °C底部预热将峰值压入力从1600 N降低至约1100 N。
infographic.watch_item: 对于超出所测试焊接参数和实验配置的情况，其预测可靠性尚未得到证实。

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.

infographic.key_insight: Among three tested D-gun spray distances, 190 mm produced Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 with the lowest porosity and best corrosion resistance in 1 M H₂SO₄.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray distance can improve coating integrity and corrosion protection for DSS 2205 components exposed to acidic environments.
method: D-gun spray Cr₃C₂–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm.
Examine coating morphology and porosity using SEM.
Evaluate corrosion at room temperature using OCP, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, and potentiodynamic polarization.

infographic.watch_item: The reported optimum applies to the tested distances and room-temperature acid conditions; long-term service durability and performance outside these conditions remain unverified.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments

zh-Hans.title: 喷涂距离对酸性环境下DSS 2205表面D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层兼具陶瓷的硬度与金属的韧性，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。爆炸喷涂（D-gun）是最有前景的热喷涂技术之一，可制备高质量的陶瓷涂层。Cr3C2–NiCr涂层因其优异的力学特性和耐腐蚀特性而适用。本研究采用1 M H₂SO₄，在强腐蚀性酸性条件下评估了D-gun喷涂Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的性能。该溶液作为标准化实验室电解液，用于评估与工业酸性环境相关的耐腐蚀性；研究考察了喷涂距离等关键工艺变量，喷涂距离对孔隙率、附着力、粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能具有至关重要的影响。为研究Cr3C2–NiCr在酸性条件下的行为，分别在170 mm、180 mm和190 mm三种喷涂距离下，在双相不锈钢（DSS）2205表面喷涂了Cr3C2–NiCr。室温下，在1 M H₂SO₄溶液中通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化评估了涂层的电化学活性。SEM表面形貌观察显示，涂层呈致密层片状结构，孔隙率由170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，表明颗粒熔融程度和涂层致密性得到改善。在190 mm距离下沉积的涂层表现出最佳电化学性能，腐蚀速率最低，为0.113 mmpy，而未涂覆基体的腐蚀速率为2.60 mmpy。所有涂覆试样均具有均匀且致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm是在DSS 2205表面制备高完整性Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在强腐蚀性工业酸性环境中运行的部件提供更强的腐蚀防护。本研究表明，优化D-gun喷涂距离可显著影响DSS 2205表面Cr₃C₂–25NiCr涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。所建立的工艺–微观结构–性能关系为优化D-gun涂层制备参数、提高其在强腐蚀性酸性环境中的耐腐蚀性提供了科学依据。

infographic.key_insight: 在所测试的三种D-gun喷涂距离中，190 mm下制备的DSS 2205表面Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层孔隙率最低，在1 M H₂SO₄中的耐腐蚀性最佳。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂距离可提高涂层完整性，并增强暴露于酸性环境中的DSS 2205部件的腐蚀防护能力。
method: 在170、180和190 mm喷涂距离下，采用D-gun将Cr₃C₂–NiCr喷涂到DSS 2205表面。
使用SEM观察涂层形貌并测定孔隙率。
在室温下，采用OCP、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化评估腐蚀行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 孔隙率由170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%；190 mm下制备的涂层腐蚀速率为0.113 mm/年，而未涂覆DSS 2205的腐蚀速率为2.60 mm/年。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层，并系统研究和比较了这些涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能及耐蚀性。结果表明，APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体，因此这三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更好。耐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 V，相对于SCE）、最低的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）和最大的腐蚀电阻（20438.5 Ω）。在这四种涂层中，APS涂层的耐蚀性最差。

title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

zh-Hans.title: 因瓦钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 因瓦钢的热膨胀系数极低，因此被广泛用于航空航天复合材料成型模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，本研究采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对因瓦钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形态演变及电弧特性的影响，为因瓦钢焊接工艺优化提供重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大导致反冲压力增大，从而增大熔深和小孔尺寸，强化熔池整体流动，且在高功率下电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，提高焊接速度会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流动速度和冷却速率增大；此外，高速下电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大会增强电弧力，促进焊缝宽度增大并强化熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更加稳定。

title: Multi-objective deep deterministic policy gradient for cobot trajectory planning in automotive spot welding
authors: Batyrkhan Omarov
abstract: Introduction Autonomous trajectory planning is a fundamental challenge in collaborative robotic spot welding because positioning accuracy, motion smoothness, operational safety, energy use, and production efficiency must be optimized simultaneously under industrial constraints. Methods This paper presents a Pareto-Guided Multi-Objective Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (PMO-DDPG) framework for autonomous cobot trajectory planning in automotive spot welding. The framework combines a deterministic actor with four objective-specific critics for accuracy, smoothness, safety, and productivity, together with phase-dependent preferences for the approach, alignment, welding, and retraction stages. The principal novelty is a two-level multi-objective design that preserves six normalized physical reward components, maps them to four specialized critics for phase-dependent actor updates, and uses a non-dominated policy archive for Pareto-guided selection while retaining actor-only online inference. Simulation and industrial experiments assessed convergence, trajectory quality, collision avoidance, energy consumption, cycle time, success rate, and latency. Results Relative to the Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) baseline, PMO-DDPG reduced trajectory error by 66.4%, collision rate by 82.1%, energy consumption by 15.5%, cycle time by 22.0%, and inference latency by 22.7%, while increasing the success rate by 7.5 percentage points. The proposed method achieved 1.08 mm trajectory error, a 1.2% collision rate, 3.65 kJ energy consumption, a 3.87 s cycle time, a 94.6% success rate, and 21.5 ms inference time. Pareto-front analysis produced non-dominated operating points for different manufacturing priorities, and 100 industrial trials confirmed sub-millimeter positioning and repeatable vision-guided welding. Discussion Within the evaluated simulation and industrial test settings, and without a formal significance test, these descriptive results indicate that PMO-DDPG is a promising accurate, safe, and efficient trajectory-planning approach.

zh-Hans.title: 用于汽车点焊协作机器人轨迹规划的多目标深度确定性策略梯度
zh-Hans.abstract: 引言 自主轨迹规划是协作机器人点焊中的一项基础性挑战，因为必须在工业约束下同时优化定位精度、运动平滑性、作业安全性、能耗和生产效率。方法 本文提出了一种帕累托引导的多目标深度确定性策略梯度（PMO-DDPG）框架，用于汽车点焊中的协作机器人自主轨迹规划。该框架将一个确定性行动者与四个分别针对精度、平滑性、安全性和生产率的评价者相结合，并引入接近、对准、焊接和回撤阶段各自的偏好。其主要创新在于一种两层多目标设计：保留六个归一化物理奖励分量，将其映射至四个专门的评价者，以实现随阶段变化的行动者更新，并利用非支配策略档案进行帕累托引导的选择，同时保持在线推理仅使用行动者。仿真和工业实验评估了收敛性、轨迹质量、避碰能力、能耗、周期时间、成功率和延迟。结果 与软行动者-评价者（SAC）基线相比，PMO-DDPG 将轨迹误差降低了 66.4%，碰撞率降低了 82.1%，能耗降低了 15.5%，周期时间缩短了 22.0%，推理延迟降低了 22.7%，同时将成功率提高了 7.5 个百分点。所提方法实现了 1.08 mm 的轨迹误差、1.2% 的碰撞率、3.65 kJ 的能耗、3.87 s 的周期时间、94.6% 的成功率和 21.5 ms 的推理时间。帕累托前沿分析得出了适用于不同制造优先需求的非支配运行点，100 次工业试验确认了亚毫米级定位能力和可重复的视觉引导焊接。讨论 在所评估的仿真和工业测试条件下，且未进行正式显著性检验的情况下，这些描述性结果表明，PMO-DDPG 是一种有前景的高精度、安全且高效的轨迹规划方法。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr coating properties depend on powder morphology and spray method: detonation spraying favors hardness, while HVOF yields a dense, uniform coating with low friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting the powder and spray process can help improve wear resistance and durability of machine parts operating under high loads and intensive friction.

Examine powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF与爆炸喷涂制备WC–Co–Cr涂层的组织形成及耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了对比分析。研究分析了原始粉末的形貌，并利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散谱（EDS）分析了涂层的微观组织及物相组成。结果表明，使用均匀、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状组织，且碳化物相在金属基体中均匀分布。爆炸喷涂制备的涂层硬度更高（平均显微硬度为1449 HV），而HVOF制备的涂层则具有高致密度、均匀的微观组织和较低的摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。对比分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些研究结果有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于强烈摩擦和高载荷条件下的运行尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr涂层的性能取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法：爆炸喷涂有利于提高硬度，而HVOF可获得致密、均匀且摩擦系数低的涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 选择合适的粉末和喷涂工艺，有助于提高在高载荷和强烈摩擦条件下运行的机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性。

title: High-resolution topology-preserving instance segmentation network for vision-based measurement system of dense welding material stubs
authors: Xinyu Chen, YuChao Chen, Yan Ren, Guangming Lv, Meng Zhang, Wang Yuan
abstract: Abstract Accurate counting and morphological analysis of welding electrodes and wire stubs are essential for warehouse data management in welding factories. However, the visual recognition of welding material stubs in real-world industrial applications is frequently hindered by issues such as missed detections, false detections, and imprecise boundary localization. To address these metrological and visual perception challenges, this paper proposes a novel High-resolution Topology-Preserving Instance Segmentation Network (HTP-Net). The proposed end-to-end architecture seamlessly integrates three core designs to realize precise decoupling and robust counting of dense targets.Specifically, a Wavelet-Driven Edge-Preserving (WEP) module is designed to retain subtle physical boundaries without loss during feature downsampling. Concurrently, a Long-Range Topology Representation Block (LTR-Block) mitigates topological disconnections resulting from extreme target slenderness by global context modeling. Finally, an Orientation-Driven Instance Segmentation Head (ODI-Seg) leverages rotational geometric priors to fundamentally resolve excessive NMS and overlapping mask artifacts. Notably, across both our custom and public datasets of dense slender materials, HTP-Net achieves substantial performance gains over existing methods, improving mAP 50 scores by at least 1.2% and up to 55.3%. Furthermore, we developed an intelligent counting system for welding materials powered by the proposed model, which has been deployed and validated in a real-world factory environment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the integrated system achieves average recognition accuracies of 99% and 94% for electrode and wire stubs, respectively.

infographic.key_insight: HTP-Net improves instance segmentation of dense, slender welding material stubs by preserving boundaries, modeling long-range topology, and using orientation-aware predictions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: More reliable stub counting and shape measurement can support automated inventory management in welding factories.
method: Wavelet-driven edge preservation retains subtle boundaries during feature downsampling.
Long-range topology modeling reduces fragmentation of slender targets.
Orientation-driven segmentation uses rotational priors to reduce excessive suppression and overlapping masks.

infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify dataset sizes, inference speed, or robustness across factory imaging conditions, leaving deployment generalizability uncertain.
infographic.paper_title: High-resolution topology-preserving instance segmentation network for vision-based measurement system of dense welding material stubs

zh-Hans.title: 用于密集焊材短段视觉测量系统的高分辨率拓扑保持实例分割网络
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 对焊条和焊丝短段进行准确计数与形态分析，对于焊接工厂的仓储数据管理至关重要。然而，在实际工业应用中，焊材短段的视觉识别常受到漏检、误检和边界定位不精确等问题的影响。为应对这些计量与视觉感知挑战，本文提出了一种新型高分辨率拓扑保持实例分割网络（HTP-Net）。所提出的端到端架构无缝集成了三项核心设计，以实现密集目标的精确解耦与稳健计数。具体而言，设计了小波驱动的边缘保持（WEP）模块，在特征下采样过程中无损保留细微的物理边界。同时，长程拓扑表征模块（LTR-Block）通过全局上下文建模，缓解目标极度细长所导致的拓扑断裂。最后，方向驱动的实例分割头（ODI-Seg）利用旋转几何先验，从根本上解决过度 NMS 和掩膜重叠伪影问题。值得注意的是，在我们自建的密集细长材料数据集和公共数据集上，HTP-Net 相较现有方法均取得了显著的性能提升，mAP 50 得分提升幅度最低为 1.2%，最高达 55.3%。此外，我们基于所提出的模型开发了焊材智能计数系统，并已在真实工厂环境中部署和验证。大量实验表明，该集成系统对焊条短段和焊丝短段的平均识别准确率分别达到 99% 和 94%。

infographic.key_insight: HTP-Net 通过保留边界、建模长程拓扑以及采用方向感知预测，提升了密集细长焊材短段的实例分割性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 更可靠的短段计数与形状测量可为焊接工厂的自动化库存管理提供支持。

infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，在自建数据集和公共数据集上，相较现有方法，mAP50 提升了 1.2%–55.3%；工厂验证中，焊条短段和焊丝短段的平均识别准确率分别达到 99% 和 94%。

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

infographic.key_insight: A physics-grounded digital twin combining thermal simulation and Gaussian-process surrogates shows promise for screening robotic welding conditions and control strategies before in-space joining experiments.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Fast surrogate predictions could support adaptive weld control when robot travel speed changes, helping maintain target weld geometry.
method: Finite-volume thermal model with phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and local pressure; gravity assessed separately.
Gaussian-process and neural-network surrogates evaluated with repeated five-fold cross-validation.
Simulated UR5 seam tracking with proportional adjustment of the power-source setting.

infographic.watch_item: Results are simulation-only; thermal-vacuum, reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop validation remain necessary.
infographic.paper_title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins

zh-Hans.title: 通过基于物理的数字孪生降低用于空间金属连接的机器人焊接风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 随着空间服务、制造与装配受到日益广泛的关注，用于模块化建造和在轨维修的可靠金属连接技术再次成为研究焦点。机器人焊接具有应用前景，但对其在低重力和低压条件下运行的特性仍缺乏充分认识，且接近实际飞行条件的试验有限。英国航天局支持的 ISPARK 项目正在开发一种基于物理的数字孪生，以系统化地降低工艺风险。本文评估了一个基于模型的原型，该原型结合了有限体积焊接熔池热模型、高斯过程（GP）与神经网络代理模型，以及仿真六轴机械臂。该简化模型包含固液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力参数。重力通过静水压力与毛细压力之比单独评估，不进入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八个输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出的边界工况中，80 个求解器响应中的 74 个落在 GP 的标称 90% 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，包括缩放处理和预测方差计算。在一项仿真 UR5 L 形焊缝研究中，比例控制器在拐角附近焊接行进速度下降时调整一元化焊接电源设定值。有限体积模型复评发现，全部 12 个闭环运行点和 12 个开环运行点中的 9 个均处于示例性的 1.0-3.0 mm 根面焊缝宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试前使用该框架筛选焊接工况和控制策略。仍需开展热真空试验、针对性低重力试验和机器人硬件在环研究，以评估该模型与控制器。

infographic.key_insight: 结合热仿真与高斯过程代理模型的基于物理的数字孪生，有望用于在空间连接实验前筛选机器人焊接工况和控制策略。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 快速代理模型预测可在机器人焊接行进速度变化时支持自适应焊接控制，帮助维持目标焊缝几何形状。
method: 采用包含相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力的有限体积热模型；重力单独评估。
采用重复五折交叉验证评估高斯过程与神经网络代理模型。
仿真 UR5 焊缝跟踪，并通过比例控制调整焊接电源设定值。
infographic.evidence_signal: GP 在全部八个输出上的表现均优于神经网络；74/80 个留出工况的求解器响应落在标称 90% 预测区间内，有限体积核验表明，12/12 个闭环运行点和 9/12 个开环运行点处于示例性宽度范围内。
infographic.watch_item: 结果仅来自仿真；仍需开展热真空、低重力和机器人硬件在环验证。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning outperformed the multitask neural network on all three welding-property predictions, with the largest improvement in ultimate tensile strength (UTS).
infographic.engineering_relevance: Predicting UTS, weld hardness, and heat-affected zone (HAZ) hardness can support welding process assessment and structural-integrity decisions.
method: Compare multitask neural networks and stacking ensembles on a shared welding dataset.
Use shared hidden representations with task-specific outputs in the multitask network.
Evaluate each property using RMSE and R².
infographic.evidence_signal: Stacking achieved R² values of 0.9863, 0.9782, and 0.8453 for UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness, respectively, versus 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407 for the multitask network.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract omits dataset size, validation protocol, and RMSE scaling, limiting assessment of generalizability and practical error magnitude.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习在预测焊接应用中的极限抗拉强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和热影响区（HAZ）硬度方面的比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测极限抗拉强度（UTS）、焊道硬度和热影响区（HAZ）机械硬度等焊接性能指标，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其设计目标是让一个模型同时处理多个相互关联的任务。MTL并非为每个任务分别训练模型，而是在任务之间共享表征，使各任务能够利用共同模式，同时保留任务特有的差异。本研究基于同一数据集，比较了多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习这两种先进机器学习技术在预测上述参数方面的表现。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一类特定的多任务学习（MTL）模型，采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时各自具有任务专用的输出层。这种共享表征使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保留任务特定的输出。两种方法均采用RMSE和R²进行评估，以确定其预测准确性和总体有效性。多任务神经网络表现出较强的预测能力，其对UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的预测RMSE分别为0.1288、0.0886和0.1125，R²值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这表明其能够在相互关联的任务中实现良好的泛化。在单项任务的预测准确性方面，堆叠集成学习优于MTL：对于UTS，RMSE为0.0263，R²为0.9863；对于焊缝硬度，二者分别为0.0467和0.9782；对于HAZ硬度，二者分别为0.1109和0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法在生成高精度、任务特定的预测方面具有良好能力。这一比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，可实现高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成则在需要准确、独立预测的情况下表现更佳。两种方法在提升焊接应用的预测能力方面均展现出显著潜力，为进一步研究融合两者优势的混合模型提供了适宜的前期基础。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习在全部三项焊接性能预测中均优于多任务神经网络，其中极限抗拉强度（UTS）的预测提升幅度最大。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 预测UTS、焊缝硬度和热影响区（HAZ）硬度，可为焊接工艺评估和结构完整性决策提供支持。
method: 基于同一焊接数据集，比较多任务神经网络与堆叠集成模型。
在多任务网络中采用共享隐藏表征和任务专用输出。
使用RMSE和R²评估各项性能的预测表现。
infographic.evidence_signal: 堆叠集成对UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的预测R²值分别达到0.9863、0.9782和0.8453，而多任务网络的对应值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明数据集规模、验证方案及RMSE的缩放方式，限制了对泛化能力和实际误差大小的评估。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Dense, low-porosity Fe-based amorphous coatings improve long-term corrosion resistance, while higher humidity reduces friction and wear.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Detonation-spray parameter control can help produce protective coatings for carbon-steel components exposed to corrosion and sliding wear.
method: Deposit Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spraying.
Vary spraying parameters and examine droplet morphology and coating microstructure.
Evaluate corrosion and wear behavior under different humidity conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract links higher coating porosity to poorer long-term corrosion resistance and reports decreasing friction coefficients and wear rates with increasing humidity.
infographic.watch_item: Humidity-dependent wear results involve Si3N4 counterface balls and may not generalize to other contact materials.

zh-Hans.title: 铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为及其在不同湿度环境下的磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 在不同喷涂参数下，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀和摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷、形成具有致密微观组织的细薄层状结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷越多，其长期耐腐蚀性越低。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层在不同湿度条件下的磨损行为具有重要作用。随着环境湿度升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料，使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统通过火焰喷涂制备涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气与乙炔的比值（O₂/C₂H₂）分别调整为1.0、1.1和1.2。使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数。对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。随着O₂/C₂H₂比值增大，涂层组织趋于致密，孔隙率由1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度由4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度则由22.14 ± 4.3 MPa升至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。在O₂/C₂H₂比值为1.1时，获得了最高的平均显微硬度，为1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层具有最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比值是调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学特性的有效手段。

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone-implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti-HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti-HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

zh-Hans.title: 远端承重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面与临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端承重植入物（DWBIs）是一类在临床上新兴的承重医疗器械，其生物材料设计、表面结构与生物力学性能紧密耦合。其成功不仅取决于恢复经股截肢康复中的远端支撑，还取决于金属、陶瓷及复合生物材料界面能否在承受循环载荷的同时促进持久的骨—植入物整合。然而，远端支撑也会改变骨—植入物界面处的弯矩、剪应力、微动、涂层耐久性及生物学需求。本系统综述综合了DWBI概念、几何优化、结合步态时相载荷的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（FGMs）、梯度Ti-HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据及临床转化路径。对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估研究趋势、验证深度及转化准备度。然而，超过一半的实证证据仍停留在台架试验或仿真层面，动物研究和人体/临床研究仅构成较小的验证层。在所纳入文献中，以HAp为核心的表面或块体材料工程研究占据了相当比例；然而，梯度Ti-HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来自非DWBI生物材料研究及机制类比研究，支持的是机制上的合理性，而非针对DWBI的专门验证。从机制上看，DWBI应被理解为一个整合的生物材料—力学系统，将宏观几何形状、金属/陶瓷表面结构、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态时相载荷、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定及临床工作流程相联系。临床转化将需要符合患者实际情况的载荷条件、经过验证的有限元分析流程、器械层面的疲劳与涂层完整性测试、标准化的体内评价终点、协调统一的康复方案，以及登记系统支持的临床随访，从而将力学上的合理性与持久的生物学固定及患者层面的获益联系起来。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

zh-Hans.title: 利用钻孔-凸台配合几何结构与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 航空航天和汽车行业对轻质高强材料的需求日益增长，使AA2024-T351等铝合金因其出色的强度重量比而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中获得可靠接头仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究着重优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。受传统榫卯接头启发，研究引入了一种新型钻孔-凸台配合几何结构，以增强机械互锁并改善焊接接头的完整性。采用L18正交表系统设计试验，以评估抗拉强度和抗扭强度。试验在一台定制改装的普通车床上进行，并将摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何形状和摩擦时间选为可控工艺参数。同时，采用集成残差网络、紧凑型注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络等先进深度学习模型，根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，摩擦压力30 MPa、顶锻压力70 MPa、主轴转速2200 rpm、钻孔-凸台配合几何结构以及摩擦时间4 min的最优参数组合获得了优异的力学性能，抗拉强度达到538 MPa，抗扭强度达到325 MPa。与传统平面-平面对接接头相比，钻孔-凸台配合结构表现出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在各深度学习模型中，集成残差网络的预测精度最高，R²值约为0.81，有效捕捉了工艺参数与焊接接头强度之间的复杂关系。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

zh-Hans.title: 不同工艺条件下爆炸喷涂制备的钛基涂层的表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文描述了二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的表面性能随爆炸喷涂条件的变化关系。研究发现，通过选取喷涂工艺参数的特定值，可以在生产过程中控制表面粗糙度、表面层厚度及其疏水性等性能。确定了使所制备涂层具有最大疏水性的爆炸喷涂工艺参数最优值。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度随喷嘴移动速度的变化符合反幂律关系。粗糙度和接触角随喷涂距离的变化符合抛物线规律。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，并确定使涂层具有最佳疏水性的最优喷涂工况。

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

zh-Hans.title: 超声纳米晶表面改性后Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 研究了经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）处理的爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌。对每种沉积工艺制备的四个处理样品进行了评估，采用的静载荷为20和30 N，振动振幅为20和30 µm。在300 mN载荷、10 s保载时间下测量了仪器化硬度。DS样品的硬度为820–970 HV，而HVOF样品的硬度范围更宽，为546–1165 HV。最高硬度分别出现在20 N/20 µm条件下处理的DS-T1样品和30 N/30 µm条件下处理的HVOF-T4样品。划痕试验后获取的SEM视场显示，两组涂层均存在不均匀的表面衬度和裂纹状不连续区域。这些观察结果为试验后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但无法单独识别由UNSM引起的损伤，也无法确定抗划伤性能的排序。六个处理样品的可用平均摩擦系数作为补充观察结果予以报告。结果表明，硬度响应因样品而异，并强调有必要结合表面完整性评估局部力学性能。

title: STUDY OF TRIBOLOGICAL PROPERTIES OF BIOCOATINGS BY DETONATION SPRAYING METHOD
authors: Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина, Daryn Baizhan, Temirlan Alimbekuly, Akbar S. Alibekov
abstract: In this study, bioactive hydroxyapatite coatings were deposited on commercially pure Grade 2 titanium substrates by detonation spraying at different O₂/C₂H₂ ratios in the range of 2.6-3.7. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed the predominance of the hydroxyapatite phase with partial formation of α-tricalcium phosphate, which is attributed to high temperatures and intense dynamic processes in the detonation jet. The formed coatings exhibit pronounced hydrophobicity, high structural heterogeneity, and a well-developed surface microrelief, promoting improved interaction with bone tissue and accelerated osseointegration. Tribological tests conducted under dry conditions and in Ringer’s solution demonstrated a significant increase in wear resistance compared to uncoated Grade 2 titanium. The best friction characteristics and the lowest wear volume were observed for coatings deposited at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 3.0 and 3.3, which is associated with an optimal combination of crystallinity, phase composition, and adhesion strength. Coatings formed under these conditions provide stable tribological behavior in physiological environments. The obtained results confirm the prospects of detonation-sprayed hydroxyapatite for improving the durability, biocompatibility, and operational reliability of titanium implants.
venue: Bulletin of Shakarim University Technical Sciences

infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing the spray gas ratio could improve the wear durability of titanium implants in physiological environments.

zh-Hans.title: 爆炸喷涂法制备生物涂层的摩擦学性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用爆炸喷涂法，在O₂/C₂H₂比值为2.6-3.7的不同条件下，将生物活性羟基磷灰石涂层沉积于Grade 2工业纯钛基体上。X射线衍射分析证实，涂层以羟基磷灰石相为主，并有部分α-磷酸三钙形成，这归因于爆炸射流中的高温和强烈动态过程。所形成的涂层表现出显著的疏水性、高度的结构非均匀性和发育充分的表面微观起伏形貌，有助于改善与骨组织的相互作用并加速骨整合。在干燥条件和林格氏液中进行的摩擦学试验表明，与未涂覆的Grade 2钛相比，涂层的耐磨性显著提高。在O₂/C₂H₂比值为3.0和3.3时沉积的涂层具有最佳的摩擦特性和最低的磨损体积，这与结晶度、相组成和结合强度的最优组合有关。在这些条件下形成的涂层在生理环境中表现出稳定的摩擦学行为。所得结果证实，爆炸喷涂羟基磷灰石在提高钛植入物的耐久性、生物相容性和服役可靠性方面具有应用前景。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂羟基磷灰石涂层提高了钛的耐磨性，其中O₂/C₂H₂比值为3.0和3.3时的摩擦学性能最佳。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂气体比值可能提高钛植入物在生理环境中的耐磨耐久性。
method: 在O₂/C₂H₂比值为2.6–3.7的条件下，将羟基磷灰石沉积于Grade 2钛上。
利用X射线衍射鉴定涂层物相。
在干燥条件和林格氏液中评估摩擦与磨损性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，涂层以羟基磷灰石为主，并形成部分α-磷酸三钙；与未涂覆的钛相比，耐磨性提高；气体比值为3.0和3.3时，磨损体积最低。
infographic.watch_item: 植入物的长期耐久性和骨整合的改善仍需通过所报告的实验室摩擦学试验之外的研究加以验证。
